name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-07-06, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.84 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
